name: useGeminiNano
summary: Gemini Nano running on the phone, with no network and no API key.
plain: Chat with a model that runs entirely on the device. Nothing leaves the phone and it works offline, but the model is small and the context is short. Check status first: the weights are managed by the system and may need downloading once.
description: Wraps the ML Kit GenAI Prompt API on AICore through the pixel-nano module. The model is owned by the system, not bundled with the app, so checkStatus can report that a download is required; download reports progress as it runs. AICore keeps no conversation history, so each turn re-sends a capped transcript built by buildNanoTurn. Latency and time to first token are measured around the native call, and output token counts come from the on-device tokenizer, so the performance figures are real rather than estimated. There is no cloud fallback: if the model is unavailable, sendMessage appends an error entry.

returns.name: status
returns.desc: Model readiness. Gate every call on this.

returns.name: isAvailable
returns.desc: Convenience for status === "available".

returns.name: info
returns.desc: Base model name, token limit, and which features this build supports (system prompt, thinking mode, structured output, caching).

returns.name: messages
returns.desc: Conversation so far. Entries with role system are local errors, not model output.

returns.name: partial
returns.desc: Text streamed so far for the in-flight reply. Render this for a live typing effect.

returns.name: thoughts
returns.desc: Reasoning steps when thinking mode is enabled and supported.

returns.name: isGenerating
returns.desc: True while a reply is being produced.

returns.name: downloadedBytes
returns.desc: Progress while the model downloads.

returns.name: isDownloading
returns.desc: True during download.

returns.name: isWarmingUp
returns.desc: Whether a warm-up is running. Pairs with `warmupMs`, which reports how long the last one took.

returns.name: warmupMs
returns.desc: How long the last warm-up took to load the model into memory.

returns.name: lastLatencyMs
returns.desc: Wall time of the last call, measured natively.

returns.name: lastFirstTokenMs
returns.desc: Time to the first streamed token, which is what perceived responsiveness depends on.

returns.name: lastOutputTokens
returns.desc: Tokens produced, counted by the on-device tokenizer.

returns.name: lastDecodeTokensPerSec
returns.desc: Generation speed after the first token. Derived from the two figures above.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Last failure message, for example a busy model or a request over the token limit.

returns.name: temperature
returns.desc: Sampling temperature applied to every turn, 0.7 by default. Lower is more deterministic.

returns.name: topK
returns.desc: Top-k sampling cutoff, 40 by default.

returns.name: candidateCount
returns.desc: How many candidates the model generates, 1 by default. Each one costs latency.

returns.name: maxOutputTokens
returns.desc: Ceiling on the reply, 1024 by default. It shares info.tokenLimit with the prompt and the re-sent transcript.

returns.name: thinkingMode
returns.desc: Whether thinking is requested. Only honoured when info.thinkingModeAvailable is true; elsewhere thoughts comes back empty.

returns.name: systemInstruction
returns.desc: The standing instruction. Sent as a SystemInstruction part when AICore supports one, otherwise prefixed to the prompt — either way it is re-sent every turn, because AICore keeps no history.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

actions.name: setSystemInstruction(text)
actions.desc: Sets the standing instruction used by every later turn.

inputs.name: text
inputs.desc: How the model should behave. It counts against info.tokenLimit on every turn, so keep it short.

actions.output: Returns nothing; the next sendMessage uses it.

actions.name: setTemperature(n) / setTopK(n) / setCandidateCount(n) / setMaxOutputTokens(n)
actions.desc: Generation parameters applied to every later turn.

inputs.name: value
inputs.desc: Temperature 0 to 1, top-k a positive integer, candidate count how many replies to generate, max output tokens the reply ceiling within info.tokenLimit.

actions.output: Returns nothing; the values are read on the next call.

actions.name: setThinkingMode(on)
actions.desc: Requests thinking mode. Check info.thinkingModeAvailable first; where it is false the request is dropped and thoughts stays empty.

inputs.name: on
inputs.desc: Whether to ask the model to think before answering.

actions.name: download()
actions.desc: Asks AICore to fetch the model weights.
actions.output: Resolves with the status after the attempt, or "unavailable" when it failed. Progress arrives in downloadedBytes while it runs.

actions.name: warmup()
actions.desc: Loads the model into AICore ahead of the first prompt so the first reply is not slow.
actions.output: Resolves with the wall time in milliseconds, or null when the warm-up failed. The same value lands in warmupMs.

actions.name: sendMessage(text)
actions.desc: Sends a chat turn with streaming, appending both the question and the reply to messages.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.desc: The user's turn. Blank or whitespace-only input is ignored.

actions.output: Resolves when the reply is complete. Tokens accumulate in partial while it streams; failures arrive as a system-role entry in messages, never as a rejection.

actions.name: generate(prompt, options?)
actions.desc: One-shot generation outside the conversation, with optional per-call parameters.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.desc: The complete prompt; no history is added.

inputs.name: options
inputs.desc: Per-call overrides: systemInstruction, temperature, topK, candidateCount, maxOutputTokens, seed, thinking, imageBase64 for a multimodal turn.

actions.output: Resolves with { text, finishReason, thoughts, latencyMs, firstTokenMs }. Throws E_NANO_* on failure; there is no fallback.

actions.name: countTokens(prompt, options?)
actions.desc: Measures a prompt with the on-device tokenizer before sending it.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.desc: Text exactly as it would be sent.

inputs.name: options
inputs.desc: The same options the real call would use, since they affect the count.

actions.output: Resolves with the token count, or null when the tokenizer is unavailable. Compare it against info.tokenLimit.

actions.name: clearMessages()
actions.desc: Empties the conversation and the thinking output.
actions.output: Returns nothing. AICore keeps no history of its own, so this is the whole reset.

actions.name: setModelConfig(stage, preference)
actions.desc: Chooses the model track AICore serves. The next call creates a new client.

inputs.name: stage
inputs.desc: Production build or the Developer Preview track. Preview models are slower and refuse more often.

inputs.name: preference
inputs.desc: Full favours quality, fast favours latency.

actions.output: Resolves once the config is applied and status and info have been re-read.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Re-reads status and model facts from AICore.
actions.output: Resolves once status and info have been updated. On failure status becomes unavailable and error is set.

actions.name: summarize(text, options?)
actions.desc: On-device summarization through ML Kit GenAI.
actions.output: `Promise<SummarizeResult>` — `{ summary, latencyMs, engine, source }`; **throws** on failure

agentNote: Always branch on status before calling. The model is foreground-only and single-turn, so keep the transcript short and send long or background work to the cloud hook.
